cohort: The study participants included 19,574 patients who underwent cesarean section and 200 patients who underwent myomectomy between 2011 and 2021.
finding: Abdominal wall endometriomas developed in 1.04% of patients who delivered by cesarean section, and development was significantly higher in Group I where estrogen levels were elevated (p < 0.001).
